metadata.description: Candidate words to potentially add to the dictionary

candidates.notes: to flare up, to burst into flames
to be reborn, to be reincarnated
to keenly feel, to realize acutely
to reflect on, to look back
just when, on the verge of
to glare at, to stare down
even if one concedes the point
to dress someone, to put on
to be able to sleep; sleeping
poster girl, face of a shop
to flap wings, to take flight
to throw on, to wear loosely
to flutter, to wave, to turn
men and women of all ages
taking off one's hat, hats off
to sit down, to take a seat
to bloom, to blossom, to flourish
to hear about, to learn of
to start, to establish, to revive
to tell, to let someone hear
two sides of the same coin
to come and go, to pass by
to gaze at; to keep in sight
spirit of words, power of words
to entrust, to leave in care of
to crowd into, to rush to
to boast, to be proud of
to deceive, to fudge, to cheat
to preach, to explain, to advocate
to look back at; to get revenge
to step forward, take a step
across the board, all in a row
